verdict.rationale: gstack ships a top-level router skill that sends any gstack request to the right specialist skill (planning, review, QA, shipping, debugging, security, design). Skills carry trigger aliases, e.g. QA's "quality check", "test the app", "run QA". Domain skills are injected automatically into prompt context when the agent works on a matching host. However, most skills are presented as slash commands, and nothing documents descriptions written specifically for model-driven auto-activation. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that skills auto-trigger from task context without manual invocation, guidance on how descriptions are engineered for activation accuracy, and independent or hands-on evidence that the right skill fires reliably.
